summary: This directory serves as the dedicated test suite for verifying the logic and functionality of the package analysis components. It isolates unit and integration tests to ensure the accuracy and reliability of analytical operations within the project.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of analytical operations
Validate expected outputs for given inputs
Ensure stability of core analysis logic
relationships: Tests validate the logic implemented by the package analyzer components.
The test suite acts as a quality assurance layer for the analysis operations.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the source logic
